Green Bay area FAQs

Planning care through the local office.

Answers about services, appointment requests, insurance and visiting the clinic.

Can I request care at the De Pere office without a referral?

Yes. You can contact Behavioral Health Clinic directly to request care at the De Pere office.

What services and age groups are supported at the Green Bay area clinic?

BHC offers therapy, psychological and diagnostic assessments, and medication management for children, teens and adults.

What appointment formats are offered?

BHC provides in-person care at 400 Reid St N in De Pere and online appointments. The available format depends on the service.

Does Behavioral Health Clinic accept insurance?

Behavioral Health Clinic accepts most major insurance plans. Coverage and out-of-pocket costs depend on the plan and service. View the current accepted insurance plans.

What should I include when I request an appointment?

Share the main concern, the age of the person seeking care, insurance information, and the preferred appointment format. You do not need to choose a clinician or service first.

Where is the Green Bay area clinic?

The Green Bay area clinic is at 400 Reid St N, De Pere, WI 54115. Office hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The office is closed Saturday and Sunday.
